tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(doctor): delegated-worker-guard remedy names the layer's real fix

The old remedy text — "run ethos seed to refresh (a repo-local file must be
hand-edited or deleted first)" — was written as if only the repo-local
layer could ever need a manual fix, but ethos seed only ever writes the
global layer (cmd/ethos seed.go seeds ~/.punt-labs/ethos/). A stale GLOBAL
file's remedy was exactly the no-op command an upgrader had just run
(GH #525).

CheckDelegatedWorkerArchetypes now splits stale names by layer and states
the layer-correct action: a global file names ethos seed (now a working
repair per the additive-merge fix) and a repo-local file names the actual
path to hand-edit or delete, since seed never reaches it.
EOF
)"
